# Generated by KRRI docking. Estimator .cpp/.h files are unchanged upstream.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(ov_init)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(rclcpp REQUIRED)
find_package(Eigen3 REQUIRED)
find_package(OpenCV 4 REQUIRED)
find_package(Boost REQUIRED COMPONENTS system filesystem thread date_time)
find_package(Ceres REQUIRED)
find_package(ov_core REQUIRED)
add_library(ov_init_lib SHARED
  src/dummy.cpp
  src/ceres/Factor_GenericPrior.cpp
  src/ceres/Factor_ImageReprojCalib.cpp
  src/ceres/Factor_ImuCPIv1.cpp
  src/ceres/State_JPLQuatLocal.cpp
  src/init/InertialInitializer.cpp
  src/dynamic/DynamicInitializer.cpp
  src/static/StaticInitializer.cpp
  src/sim/SimulatorInit.cpp)
target_compile_definitions(ov_init_lib PUBLIC ROS_AVAILABLE=2 ENABLE_ARUCO_TAGS=0)
target_include_directories(ov_init_lib PUBLIC src ${EIGEN3_INCLUDE_DIRS}
  ${Boost_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${CERES_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
ament_target_dependencies(ov_init_lib rclcpp ov_core)
target_link_libraries(ov_init_lib ${Boost_LIBRARIES} ${CERES_LIBRARIES} ${OpenCV_LIBS})
install(TARGETS ov_init_lib LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
install(DIRECTORY src/ DESTINATION include FILES_MATCHING PATTERN "*.h" PATTERN "*.hpp")
ament_export_include_directories(include)
ament_export_libraries(ov_init_lib)
ament_export_dependencies(rclcpp ov_core)
ament_package()
